# Actual-resolver accessor study

This source-only fixture freezes the current checked EngineMemory implementation and a distinct transaction candidate that caches one same-thread TLS slot address and outlines true-stop depth/deferral work. The unchanged control transaction and shared runtime headers are pinned in source-provenance.json.

The two finite kernel/runtime units exercise heap addresses, native globals and mixed operands, with constructor/destructor costs and at most32copied words per scope. DATA/BSS are existing zero-filled synthetic layouts. No original game code, assets, application package or signing material is present.

Local correctness does not establish native timing. Actual ARM measurements, iOS linked code inspection, true-stop costs and whole-game register pressure remain acceptance requirements. This fixture never promotes production source by itself.
